entries.Original: Open the map and place a flag at the location of your current treasure map
entries.Translated: 打开地图并在当前藏宝图位置放置标记

entries.Original: Use /tmap to open your current treasure map.
entries.Translated: 使用 /tmap 打开当前藏宝图。

entries.Original: Open the map with a flag set after deciphering a map.
entries.Translated: 解读地图后打开地图并设置标记。

entries.Original: Open the map with a flag set instead of the normal treasure map window.
entries.Translated: 打开地图并设置标记，而非显示普通藏宝图窗口。

entries.Original: Open the map with a flag set when hovering over a deciphered map.
entries.Translated: 悬停在已解读的地图上时打开地图并设置标记。
